l02.text: The footsteps behind you. The shape between the trees, gone the moment you looked.

l03.text: That was me. It has always been me.

l04.text: My name was Cyrrus. I was a traveller once, like you. I climbed to the Sovereign's crown, and asked the storm to answer me.

l05.text: It answered. It filled me, until there was nothing left but wind.

l06.text: You carried my heart out of the dark. You set my eyes in stone. You read my journal.

l07.text: Thank you. You have woken me completely.

l08.text: Now. Let the sky decide which of us walks home.

phase2.text: The rain will take your eyes. You won't need them.

phase3.text: You hold your ground. The wind will fix that.

phase4.text: Come, children of the squall. Feed on them.

phase5.text: No more voices. Only the storm.

d02.text: Strange. I can hear my own footsteps again.

d03.text: Keep the crown, traveller. Don't ask it for anything.
